channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Sports have never really faced major issues since PM Modi took office: Ex-WFI chief Brij Bhushan Sharan
item.description: leader and former president of the Wrestling Federation of India (WFI), Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh, praised the Pro Wrestling League (PWL) 2026 and lauded the thrilling final between Haryana Thunders and Delhi Dangal Warriors.

item.title: Oppn fails to understand, this is historic: Bihar BJP president praises Budget, slams rivals
item.description: BJP Bihar State President Sanjay Saraogi on Monday strongly defended the Union Budget 2026–27, calling it “historic” and accusing the opposition of deliberately ignoring the development push under Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s leadership, particularly for Bihar.

item.title: EAM Jaishankar to embark on three-day US visit today
item.description: External Affairs Minister (EAM) S. Jaishankar will begin a three-day visit to the United States on Monday to participate in the Critical Minerals Ministerial convened by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said.

item.title: Iraq’s parliament delays presidency vote again amid political deadlocks
item.description: The session was adjourned on Sunday (local time) after the Kurdistan Democratic Party and the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan failed to agree on a consensus candidate for the presidential post, as well as the lack of a quorum, reports Xinhua news agency.

item.title: Budget delivered boost to Bengaluru’s infrastructure & mobility: LoP in Karnataka Assembly
item.description: R Ashoka, the Leader of Opposition in Karnataka Assembly on Monday stated that the Union Budget 2026–27 has delivered a massive boost to Bengaluru’s infrastructure and mobility and rejected Opposition's claims that the Southern state was deprived of its share of outlays and projects.

item.title: ‘Rainman’ R. Madhavan talks about moment that shaped opening scene of ‘Dhurandhar’
item.description: Bollywood star R. Madhavan, who was seen playing the role IB director Ajay Sanyal in “Dhurandhar,” shared an interesting behind-the-scenes moment from the sets of the blockbuster, revealing how nature quietly rewrote the plan for the film’s opening shot.

item.title: NIA raids multiple places in Kashmir in terror-related case
item.description: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) on Monday carried out raids at multiple locations across the Kashmir Valley as part of an ongoing investigation into terror-related activities and funding networks.

item.title: NDA Parliamentary Party meet tomorrow to discuss Union Budget
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Home Minister Amit Shah, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, BJP National President Nitin Nabin, and all other NDA ministers and MPs will be present at the meeting.

item.title: Tamil Nadu completely betrayed in Union Budget 2026-27: MDMK leader
item.description: However, he claimed that those expectations have been entirely dashed, with the Centre failing to announce any significant allocations or projects for the state.

item.title: Kharge should understand PM Modi’s vision for Viksit Bharat: BJP hits back at Cong over Budget criticism
item.description: The BJP on Monday strongly defended the Union Budget 2026-27, hitting back at Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge for his sharp criticism of the government’s economic vision.
